jobs.occupation: Grow365.io söker en driven Account Manager till den svenska marknaden
jobs.description:
Account Manager till Sverige

Bli en del av Grow365.io i Aarhus

Grow365.io är ett snabbt växande mjukvaruföretag som hjälper B2B-företag att få nya kunder och öppna nya marknader genom vår AI- och automationssoftware. Vi arbetar redan med kunder som Jyllands-Posten, Kingspan, JKS och många fler — och nu söker vi en ambitiös Account Manager som vill vara med och stärka vår satsning på den svenska marknaden.

Som Account Manager får du ansvar för den svenska marknaden och blir en del av ett ungt, energiskt team i Aarhus, där försäljning, rådgivning och hög prestation går hand i hand.

Om tjänsten

I rollen som Account Manager får du ansvar för hela säljprocessen — från första kontakt till att avtalet är på plats. Du kommer både att boka möten, hålla kundmöten online och rådgiva potentiella kunder om hur Grow365.io kan skapa tillväxt i deras verksamhet.

Du får en varierad arbetsdag där du arbetar med:

• 
Uppsökande försäljning via telefon, e-post, LinkedIn och Grow365.io

• 
Mötesbokning och kundmöten online

• 
Behovsanalys och rådgivning

• 
Uppföljning och closing

• 
Löpande sparring med ledningen och teamet

Vi erbjuder

Hos Grow365.io får du möjlighet att bygga en stark säljkarriär i ett företag med höga ambitioner och stor tillväxtpotential. Vi erbjuder bland annat:

• 
Attraktiv provisionsmodell kombinerad med fast grundlön

• 
Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter — både professionellt och personligt

• 
En spännande roll i ett tillväxtorienterat företag

• 
Professionell utrustning och grundlig onboarding

• 
En stark arbetsmiljö med högt humör och högt tempo

• 
Lön utan tak

• 
Sociala och professionella aktiviteter under året

Vem är du?

Vi föreställer oss att du är en person med energi, driv och vilja att skapa resultat. Du trivs med kundkontakt, är bra på att bygga relationer och motiveras av att arbeta målinriktat mot tydliga mål.

Vi lägger särskild vikt vid att du:

• 
Är stark i dialog via telefon och snabbt kan skapa förtroende

• 
Arbetar självständigt och strukturerat

• 
Inte är rädd för att ringa många samtal

• 
Motiveras av resultat och performance

• 
Är ansvarsfull och tar ägarskap

• 
Talar och skriver flytande svenska

Det är en fördel om du har erfarenhet av försäljning, men det är inget krav. Det viktigaste är din inställning, ditt driv och din vilja att utvecklas.

Praktisk information

Tjänsten har sin bas i Aarhus.

Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta försäljningsdirektör Mads Thomsen på tel. +45 50 42 04 78. Ansökan skickas till mads@grow365.io.

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig.

The Company

˚MEQU is a Danish MedTech company behind the ˚M Warmer System, an innovative medical device that enables healthcare professionals to deliver warm blood and IV-fluids from the point of injury to the hospital. With customers across military, tactical, emergency, HEMS, and hospital environments worldwide, our ambition is to become the global leader in blood and IV-fluid warming solutions for pre-hospital and through hospital care. Learn more about ˚MEQU: www.mequ.dk

On behalf of ˚MEQU, Best Talent is recruiting an International Product Manager.

The Team

You will join a small, ambitious Marketing team with ambitious plans and great impact on the future growth of the company. Success is driven by close collaboration across Marketing, R&D, QA/RA, Operations, and Commercial functions in a fast moving and highly cross-functional environment.

International Product Manager

Drive global product strategy for an innovative Danish MedTech company

• Shape life-saving MedTech solutions through your clinical expertise

• Collaborate with leading healthcare providers, emergency services, and military organizations

• Play a key role in the international growth of a fast-scaling Danish MedTech company with a meaningful and global purpose

The Role

We are looking for an International Product Manager who can bridge clinical insights, users’ needs, regulatory requirements, and technical development to drive successful global product strategies and commercial execution.

You will own the global product lifecycle across emergency, tactical, and hospital segments. With the United States representing ˚MEQU’s most important growth market, you will play a key role in ensuring that product positioning, roadmap priorities, and value propositions algin with the clinical, regulatory, and commercial requirements of US military, EMS, HEMS, and hospital customers.

Working across the organization, you will ensure that user insights, market needs, engineering priorities and regulatory considerations are translated into clear product direction and commercially viable solutions.

As the internal subject-matter expert within pre-hospital blood and IV transfusion, you will convert clinical challenges into prioritized product requirements that guide product development and long-term portfolio decisions. The position reports directly to the COO and requires approximately 30-50 travel days annually.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Shaping global product positioning, value propositions, and market prioritization to support successful international expansion, and continuously monitor:

• Developments in clinical standards of care.

• Tactical and military medical protocols.

• Global procurement and reimbursement structures.

• Competitive and technological developments.

• International market dynamics and commercial opportunities.

• Develop instructions for use, training materials, user guides, and educational content to support sales teams, distributors, and clinical specialists globally.

Your professional background:

You bring a clinical background within emergency medicine, pre-hospital care, HEMS, military medicine, or tactical care, combined with hands-on experience with blood and IV transfusion in critical settings. You understand the realities and challenges faced by end users in high-pressure environments.

In addition, you have commercial insight into the MedTech industry and experience supporting product positioning, launches, and international market development. Experience working with institutional customers medical device markets and understand how to position, launch, and scale products internationally. Experience with institutional and public procurement structures is highly valued.

You understand medical device development and the regulatory environment and are able to translate complex clinical needs into structured product requirements that create both customers value and commercial impact.

Your personality – You are:

• A strong communicator with who bridges clinical technical, regulatory, and commercial perspectives.

• Commercially minded with a strategic and customer-centric approach

• Structured and analytical, with the ability to balance long-term strategy and operational execution

• Proactive, self-driven, and comfortable taking ownership in a dynamic scale-up environment

• Curious, collaborative, and motivated by improving patient outcomes through innovation

˚MEQU offers you:

You will gain international exposure across tactical, emergency, and hospital markets and collaborate closely with global distributors, armed forces, and leading healthcare institutions.

• A high-impact position with global strategic product influence

• A dynamic, international, and collaborative work environment

• A diverse team of 30+ colleagues headquartered in Copenhagen

• A mission-driven culture focused on improving patient outcomes

• Competitive salary with a pension scheme and up-to-date benefits

Application:

Please send your application in English, marked ”1947/International Product Manager” to job@besttalent.dk. Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Learn more about Best Talent at www.besttalent.dk.

JYSK is strengthening its use of AI to support data-driven decision making, operational efficiency and innovation across the organization. We are now looking for an AI Delivery Lead to join our AI department at the JYSK Head Office.

As AI Delivery Lead, you are responsible for how AI initiatives are delivered – ensuring flow, execution and predictable delivery from idea to production. You work in close collaboration with the AI Product Owner, who owns the what and why, while you own the how and delivery.

In this hybrid role, you will balance driving day-to-day team execution with hands-on contribution to governance strategy.

You will work directly with cross-functional teams - data scientists, AI engineers, data engineers, platform engineers, AI enablement specialists, IT teams, and business stakeholders to ensure AI solutions are built, deployed, and adopted with high quality and speed.

You will also direct ownership of key governance tasks, guiding teams toward AI maturity, leading AI and Agent Governance assessments, and navigating compliance requirements for the EU AI Act.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

You will be responsible for making AI initiatives happen in practice, collaborating closely with teams across JYSK to drive both delivery execution and AI governance maturity.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• A hands-on delivery role with clear ownership of how AI solutions are delivered

• Direct impact on shaping JYSK's AI governance, Agent Governance, and EU AI Act compliance roadmap

• Close collaboration with an AI Product Owner and skilled technical specialists

• An international working environment with focus on execution and outcomes

• Opportunities for professional and personal development

• Freedom with responsibility in a values-driven organization

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As AI Delivery Lead, you take operational ownership of AI deliveries and drive AI governance initiatives to ensure responsible and compliant deployment. Your key responsibilities include:

• Owning the end-to-end delivery of AI initiatives from planning to production

• Driving execution based on priorities set by the AI Product Owner

• Driving and facilitating planning and delivery activities (such as planning, refinement, daily stand-up, retrospective, demos, etc.)  to ensure steady flow and progress

• Coordinating work across the AI team, IT teams and business stakeholders

• Actively removing impediments and managing dependencies across initiatives

• Following development, progress closely and ensuring timely deployments and handovers

• Ensuring transparency on progress, risks and delivery status

• Supporting good delivery practices

• Leading compliance and maturity activities in AI Governance and Agent Governance

• Conducting AI assessments to ensure solutions align with governance frameworks

• Supporting and guiding teams toward full compliance with the EU AI Act

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

We are looking for a pragmatic and delivery-focused profile who thrives in execution and close collaboration. You enjoy being close to the work, driving team flow, and taking direct responsibility for AI governance and compliance. You likely bring:

• Hands-on experience delivering solutions within AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, data products and similar

• Experience from roles such as Delivery Lead, Scrum Master, Project Manager or similar

• Solid understanding of agile principles and cross-functional teamwork

• Knowledge of AI governance, Agent Governance, or compliance frameworks such as the EU AI Act

• Practical experience with AI assessments or quality assurance in data/AI initiatives

• Ability to collaborate closely with a Product Owner while maintaining clear role boundaries

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

• A structured, proactive and solution-oriented mindset

• Experience with JIRA or similar is considered an advantage, but not a must

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Head of AI, Karan Honavar at +45 2812 8374.

Instead, when you click “I’m interested/Apply”, you will have the option to write a brief message to the hiring team. If you wish, you can use this space to share your motivation for applying or highlight anything else you feel is relevant.

ABOUT US

We believe our employees are key to our success. That is why we strive to offer development and possibilities of growing and finding new challenges within JYSK. Since our founder, Lars Larsen, opened his first store in Denmark in 1979, JYSK has expanded our global presence with stores and web shops in countries around the world.

Our three fundamental JYSK Values – Tradesman, Colleague and Corporate Spirit – express the behaviour and attitude that we can expect from each other. We trust each other, and we believe in Empowerment and freedom with responsibility. We also take pride in rewarding engagement and a great effort among our employees. With the right attitude, opportunities abound in JYSK.

JYSK wants to include everyone, no matter the age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and experience. Together, we secure our inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. Because a great mix of minds, talents and unique personalities makes us a stronger team.

The Role and Department

Our QC lab is growing in activities and looking to recruit an IT System Administrator to join our team onsite in Ballerup.

As IT system administrator at Genmab, you will provide administrative and developmental support to all our QC IT systems in our Quality Control Laboratory.

The laboratory is responsible for supporting Genmab’s innovative products by performing release and stability testing according to ICH guidelines. Systems are mainly the Labvantage Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS), but also the Empower Chromatography software and additional software controlling analytical equipment.

The role requires a detailed understanding of the LIMS and Empower systems used by QC and its maintenance requirements. The IT system administrator will own the system validation packages, the SOPs, and associated training packages.

• Liaison between System Users, Application Managers (IT) & QA.

• Manage user access administration and providing initial and on-going training for users.

• Responsible for practical aspects of maintaining the validated state of GxP systems.

• Ensure data integrity and compliance with company SOPs, requirement specifications, and cGMP regulations.

• Load and configure method templates in LIMS and Empower.

• Perform all aspects of QMS processes – Change Control, Deviations, CAPAs – for software used in QC lab.

• Report achievements and escalate issues.

•

• 
Experience with qualification of analytical instruments is desirable as you will be the owner of the validation and qualification activities

• 
Experience in leading projects and driving cross-functional initiatives/stakeholders

Sky‑Watch A/S is a leading Danish drone company that since 2009 has specialized in the development, production, and servicing of high‑technology mini UAS systems for Defense – nationally and internationally. With more than 155 dedicated employees and a strong international growth journey underway, Sky‑Watch today stands as one of the most innovative players within tactical mini UAV systems. At Sky‑Watch, robust, reliable, and advanced drone systems are developed for demanding environments and critical situations where predictability, mechanical durability, traceability and user safety are paramount.

As an ambitious scale‑up company in rapid development, Sky‑Watch is fully aware that ensuring our products, processes, and organization consistently meet the highest standards for quality, safety, and compliance is essential to our continued success in a global, highly regulated defense market.

To strengthen the company’s QHSE team, we are now looking for a passionate, inspiring and proactive QHSE Director.

Global Quality Leadership – Full Value Chain Impact – Operational Reliability

Do you want to take a central role in shaping how a high‑tech defense company secures reliability, compliance and world‑class product integrity on a global scale? As the new QHSE Director at Sky Watch, you will own and continuously evolve the company’s Quality and HSE foundation, ensuring that our products, processes and teams operate at a consistently high and predictable standard across the entire value chain.

You will be responsible for safeguarding Sky-Watch’s Quality Management System, driving compliance with AS9100, ISO 9001 and AQAP, and enabling stable, scalable execution in an increasingly demanding international defense environment. Through strong cross functional leadership and data driven governance, you will strengthen decision making, reduce operational risk, accelerate execution stability and help deliver a dependable customer experience built on safety, performance and traceability.

Joining Sky‑Watch means stepping into a fast‑growing scale‑up where reliability is a strategic differentiator — and where your expertise will directly influence both day‑to‑day operations and the company’s ongoing global growth journey.

You will report directly to the CEO, including direct leadership responsibility for the QA Manager and dotted line leadership of the QC Manager.

In this role, you act as a trusted advisor to the Executive Management Team, providing clear, fact based recommendations on quality, risk and compliance, and contributing actively to strategic decision‑making at enterprise level.

Your key responsibilities include:

• QHSE Strategy & Policy

• Sky‑Watch QMS (AS9100 / ISO 9001 / AQAP)

• Quality Governance & Risk Management

• Digital QHSE & Data Governance

• Continuous Improvement & NCR / CAPA

• Supplier Quality Requirements & APQP / PPAP

• Manufacturing Quality & QC oversight

• Audits & Compliance

• Health, Safety & Environment (in collaboration with the Health & Safety Organization / AMO)

• People Leadership & Cross‑functional Collaboration

To succeed in this role, you hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing or a related technical field, combined with at least 10 years of experience in global Quality/QHSE leadership within regulated, high‑tech industries with full value chain such as defense, aerospace or equivalent.

You have demonstrated strong results in defect reduction, execution stability and QMS maturity, and you bring hands on experience with MRB, concessions, PPAP and supplier audits. You possess deep knowledge of AS9100, AQAP and ISO 9001 requirements and are comfortable working with lifecycle product safety in a regulated environment.

You work confidently with structured problem‑solving and quality methodologies such as RCA, FMEA, Control Plans and capability analysis, and you are experienced in configuration and document control to ensure consistency and traceability. In addition, you bring strong digital QHSE literacy, using data governance, dashboards and digital adoption to create transparency, support sound decision making and drive continuous improvement across the organisation.

You are based within approximately one hour’s driving distance from Støvring and are willing to travel around 20–30 days per year.

As a person, you take ownership of your responsibilities and bring energy and commitment to your work. You are proactive and structured, balance strategic thinking with hands‑on execution, and remain calm and focused in a fast‑changing environment. With a strong analytical and curious mindset, you are able to translate complex quality, risk and compliance topics into clear, actionable messages that create understanding, alignment and strong buy‑in across senior leadership and the wider organization. You work collaboratively across functions, build trust with key stakeholders, and act as a credible role model for quality, integrity and professional judgement.

Are you energized by shaping how a large IT organization works and equally motivated by making sure new ways of working are actually adopted?

“We have recent led our transformation from taking Arla IT & Digital from a plan-build-run operating model to a product-led organization. Our ambition with this change is to strengthen end-to-end product accountability, introduce more fit-for-purpose practices, improve cross-team transparency, and create common guidance and capability-building activities across IT & Digital,” says Head of Product IT, Kasper Duus.

**

How will you make an impact**

As Experienced IT Specialist in the IT Excellence team, you will take ownership of key transformation and continuous-improvement initiatives, moving between strategic thinking, practical design, stakeholder alignment and hands-on execution. Your key responsibilities will include

• Shape and improve our IT operating model and product-led ways of working, translating ambitions into our product lifecycle model, roadmaps, roles, and processes.

• Drive adoption and anchoring of change, ensuring new ways of working become part of everyday behaviors and continue to evolve after implementation.

• Lead cross-functional transformation initiatives, creating alignment across stakeholders, clarifying ownership, and turning complex challenges into actionable solutions.

• Use data, insights, and feedback to identify improvement opportunities, challenge existing practices, and help demonstrate progress and value.

• Enable leaders and teams to succeed with change through facilitation, capability building, clear guidance, and practical tools.

This is a maternity cover position of 12 months based in Aarhus.

What will make you successful

You bring solid experience within organizational transformation, operating-model development, change management, continuous improvement, management consulting, or a similar field.

You are comfortable translating ambition into action and have experience driving change from design through implementation and adoption. You combine a structured and analytical mindset with strong stakeholder-management and facilitation skills. We expect the ideal candidate brings

• 5+ years of experience with large-scale transformation initiatives

• Experience with or understanding of product-led IT organizations

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

• Experience with organizational design, capability building, performance insights or agile/continuous-improvement practices is an advantage

Most importantly, you are pragmatic and hands-on. You are comfortable challenging existing thinking, navigating ambiguity, and creating momentum without relying on formal authority.

What do we offer?

You get the chance to shape how a large, Global IT organization works, at a time when the new operating model is being anchored. You will work with leaders and teams across Arla IT & Digital, see the direct impact of your work on everyday practice, and build experience that is valuable for your further career, in a team that cares about connecting strategy with execution.

Would you like to join us?

If you want to turn transformation ambitions into lasting change, then seize this exciting opportunity. Please apply as soon as possible, as we process applications on a continuous basis and will close the recruitment once the right candidate is found.

For additional information, please contact Kasper Duus on kasper.duus@arlafoods.com

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

jobs.occupation: Drive Technical Excellence, Lead with Confidence, and Make an Impact as Team Lead for our Hardware Automation team
jobs.description:
Are you a technically strong and decisive leader who sets high standards, takes ownership, and drives results?
At Gram Equipment, we are looking for a Team Lead – Hardware, Automation who combines solid electrical engineering expertise with a strong leadership presence and the determination to make things happen.

We are looking for someone who is confident in their technical decisions, comfortable taking responsibility, and motivated by delivering high-quality results. Someone who brings structure, challenges the status quo when needed, and has the courage to set clear expectations and follow through.

In this role, you will lead our Hardware Team within the Automation department, ensuring that we deliver safe, reliable, and production-ready electrical hardware solutions.

This is a hands-on leadership position where you will combine technical expertise with team leadership. Approximately 80% of your time will be dedicated to technical and operational activities, while 20% will focus on leadership, planning, and employee development.
Your role – technical excellence meets strong leadership
As our new Team Lead, you will take responsibility for the daily coordination, technical quality, and performance of a team of six skilled employees in Denmark and one in Turkey.

You will be expected to provide clear direction, establish priorities, and ensure that decisions are translated into action. At the same time, you will remain actively involved in engineering activities, contributing your own technical expertise to complex challenges and important projects.

An important part of your role will be to drive standardization, increase automation of engineering processes, and identify opportunities for cost optimization, helping us create more efficient, scalable, and competitive hardware solutions.

You will work closely with colleagues across Automation, Engineering, Project Management, Procurement, and Production, where your ability to communicate clearly, challenge constructively, and stand firm on technical quality and safety will be essential.

You will report to the Global Head of Automation and play an important role in strengthening the performance and capabilities of our Global Engineering & Automation organization.
Your key responsibilities
• Lead with clarity and accountability: Set clear expectations, establish priorities, make decisions, and ensure that commitments are followed through.
• Drive technical execution: Take an active role in electrical design, panel engineering, component selection, BOM development, and technical problem-solving.
• Ensure high technical standards: Review and challenge electrical solutions, maintain compliance with safety requirements, and ensure consistent engineering quality and documentation.
• Drive standardization and engineering automation: Develop and implement standardized electrical designs, components, and documentation practices. Promote automated generation of electrical drawings to reduce manual engineering effort, improve consistency, and increase efficiency.
• Focus on cost optimization: Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities through smarter design solutions, component standardization, efficient engineering processes, and close collaboration with Procurement and Production, without compromising safety, quality, or reliability.
• Take ownership of planning and delivery: Allocate resources, monitor capacity and progress, address obstacles, and proactively manage delivery risks.
• Make sound technical decisions: Evaluate complex engineering challenges, balance quality, cost, safety, and delivery requirements, and make well-founded decisions, even under pressure.
• Develop and challenge your team: Provide constructive feedback, coach employees, encourage accountability, and support the development of technical competencies.
• Strengthen cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with internal stakeholders, suppliers, and panel builders to resolve issues and ensure effective project execution.
• Drive continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to improve standards, processes, tools, and working methods, and take the initiative to turn improvements into measurable results.What we are looking for
We are looking for an experienced electrical engineering professional with a strong technical foundation and a natural ability to take the lead.

You enjoy responsibility, have a structured and analytical approach, and are comfortable making decisions and standing behind them.

Ideally, you bring:

• A relevant technical or engineering background within electrical engineering, automation, or a related field.
• Solid experience with electrical design and panel engineering for industrial machinery.
• Strong knowledge of electrical safety, technical standards, and regulatory requirements, including CE and DS/EN/IEC 60204-1.
• Experience with electrical components, BOM structures, technical documentation, and engineering standards.
• A strong understanding of standardization and an interest in automated engineering processes, including automated generation of electrical drawings.
• A commercial mindset with the ability to identify cost optimization opportunities while maintaining technical quality and compliance.
• The ability to analyze complex technical challenges and make clear, well-founded decisions.
• Experience coordinating technical work, managing priorities, and ensuring delivery against commitments.
• Previous experience in technical leadership, team coordination, or people management, or demonstrated leadership potential combined with a strong desire to take responsibility.Your personality makes the difference
For this position, your personal drive and leadership approach are just as important as your technical qualifications.

We are looking for someone who brings a strong personality, clear direction, and high professional standards to the team.

You are likely to recognize yourself in the following:

• Decisive and confident: You are comfortable taking the lead, making decisions, and addressing challenges directly rather than waiting for others to act.
• Analytical and detail-oriented: You approach technical challenges systematically, question assumptions, and base your decisions on facts and sound engineering judgment.
• Results-driven and accountable: You set ambitious but realistic expectations, take ownership, and follow through to ensure that objectives are achieved.
• Structured and quality-conscious: You value precision, consistency, and well-defined processes and are unwilling to compromise on safety or critical quality requirements.
• Assertive and constructive: You are willing to challenge ideas, address difficult issues, and stand by your professional assessments while respecting different perspectives.
• Demanding but supportive: You set high standards for yourself and others, provide clear feedback, and help your team develop the skills and confidence to succeed.
• Proactive and improvement-oriented: You identify opportunities, challenge inefficient ways of working, and drive improvements that increase efficiency, standardization, and cost competitiveness.
You have the confidence to lead experienced technical specialists, the credibility to earn their respect, and the ability to create an environment where clear expectations, professional discussions, and shared accountability lead to strong results.
What you can expect from us
At Gram Equipment, you will have the opportunity to combine your technical expertise with leadership responsibility in an engineering environment where quality, reliability, and continuous improvement are essential.

You can look forward to:

• A challenging and varied role combining hands-on engineering with people leadership.
• Responsibility for a team of skilled technical specialists.
• The opportunity to influence technical decisions, engineering standards, and ways of working.
• The opportunity to drive standardization, engineering automation, and cost optimization initiatives.
• Close collaboration across engineering disciplines and other business functions.
• The opportunity to make a visible impact on team performance, technical quality, and project delivery.
• A working environment that values ownership, professional expertise, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
• A flexible working approach, with the position primarily based in Kolding and opportunities for hybrid working.Ready to take ownership and make a difference?
If you are a technically strong engineer who enjoys taking the lead, making decisions, and driving high standards while improving engineering efficiency and cost competitiveness, this could be your next career opportunity.

Join Gram Equipment and take the lead in developing our Hardware Team and delivering high-quality, efficient, and competitive automation solutions.

**Our Purpose

**Planday from Xero is a leading digital solution that uncomplicates everyday scheduling and workforce management by making it easier for businesses and shift workers around the world to communicate, collaborate, and get work done.

Powered by a community of local industry experts, Planday provides a best-in-class digital platform that is easy to use, accurate, secure, and compliant with local needs and standards. **What You’ll Do

• Proactive identification of data gaps and the successful implementation of new data sources for advanced AI capabilities.

**What You’ll Bring With You

• Meaningful work – everyone at Planday contributes to improving the lives of shift workers around the globe

• Healthy work-life balance and autonomous approach to work. We trust in you and your abilities

Finally, our offices are not just workplaces (although they are pretty nice and well-located, we have to say!). Plandayers are open and welcoming and at Planday, everyone has the freedom and support to show their true self at work.

_At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture. As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process.

We are looking for an experienced and commercially minded Service Technology and Automation Lead to modernize our global Customer Service setup. You will drive the implementation of service technology, AI and automation to deliver best-in-class customer experience while improving operational efficiency.

Working closely with Global and Local Service teams, you will optimize processes, develop our global service platform and translate business needs into practical solutions. Your focus will be on increasing efficiency, strengthening service quality and making it easier for customers and partners to do business with us.

**Welcome to Global Sales

**You will join Global Sales, Training and Service within Demant’s Hearing Aids business, where we work to improve the lives of people with hearing loss around the world. We deliver product and sales training, commercial excellence and customer service excellence to our sales companies across Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, the Middle East and Africa, as well as to our independent distributors.

You will become part of our newly established Global Service department, consisting of 14 colleagues. Reporting to the Head of Global Service and joining the Global Service leadership team, you will help define and implement service excellence across our global organization.

**Drive Global Service Efficiency and Automation

**Joining us, you will drive the digitalization of Customer Service through standardized processes, modern technology, AI and automation. You will collaborate with local teams to identify opportunities, develop solutions and ensure successful implementation and adoption.

Success requires a good understanding of Customer Service operations and the ability to use technology to improve efficiency without compromising the personal relationships that underpin great service.

In this role, you will:

• Own and develop Salesforce Service Cloud, including its global rollout, functionality, user experience and roadmap.

• Drive platform adoption and performance, using data and insights to help markets maximize value and identify improvements.

• Implement AI and automation solutions to optimize workflows, improve service quality and increase operational efficiency.

• Define global service standards and guide markets in optimizing technologies such as IVR, workforce management and knowledge repositories.

• Develop customer and partner integrations for larger customers, maintaining the integration roadmap with Global IT.

• Drive stakeholder engagement and implementation, building alignment and momentum across global and local teams.

You can expect approximately 10–20 travel days per year to support our markets and understand local service operations.

**What You Bring

**You hold a relevant commercial master’s degree and ideally have around five years of experience in a similar function, preferably within a larger international organization. You have a track record of improving Customer Service performance and implementing new solutions.

You understand Customer Service at strategic, tactical and operational levels and know how to optimize processes, systems and ways of working. With a good commercial mindset, you recognize how service excellence contributes to customer satisfaction and business performance.

You thrive at the intersection of Customer Service, data, AI and technology. You have experience implementing AI solutions in a business context and translating insights into measurable improvements. Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud, Power BI or similar platforms is an advantage.

As a colleague, you are structured, analytical and collaborative. You can lead projects across organizational boundaries, influence and challenge stakeholders at different levels, and balance global standards with local needs. Your excellent communication and presentation skills enable you to build relationships and create engagement across cultures and functions.

**Come and join us

**This is an opportunity to shape the future of Customer Service across Demant’s global Hearing Aids business. You will work with colleagues and stakeholders across international markets to make our service operations more efficient, scalable and customer-focused through technology, AI and automation.

If you enjoy combining commercial insight, technology and collaboration to create tangible business improvements, we would like to hear from you.

Please submit your CV before the application deadline on November 5.

For inquiries regarding the application process, please use the online application form.

To learn more about the position, contact Steen Busk Marner, Head of Global Service, at skma@demant.com.

The postdoc position will be a part of the SPINE project (Strengthening Pathways and Infrastructures for Navigating Interdisciplinary Collaboration in Existing Academic Structures), funded by the Lundbeck Foundation

  We are looking for an engaged and independent researcher to help us develop and test practical ways of strengthening interdisciplinary collaboration in research and education.

  The SPINE project investigates how interdisciplinary collaboration can be better supported within existing academic structures. The project combines qualitative research, international fieldwork, and participatory action research to develop practical “plug-and-play” tools, such as methods, templates, games, and workshop formats, that can be readily used by researchers, educators, and research organisations.

   

  Your role

  As a postdoc in SPINE, you will lead the testing and refinement of tools and methods at SPINE’s test sites, including designing and facilitating intervention workshops with researchers and other stakeholders. You will evaluate and adapt approaches across different contexts and help turn research findings into practical, “plug-and-play” resources for interdisciplinary collaboration.

  The position combines research and reporting on the development and testing activities with qualitative research, but the main emphasis will be on the development, testing, and refinement of practical tools and interventions.

   

  You will also contribute to:

   	
• Conducting qualitative research and fieldwork 	
• Analysing and evaluating empirical material and interventions 	
• Working with project partners and stakeholders 	
• Disseminating findings through academic and practice-oriented outputs 	
• Teaching at the Department of Science Education   The position is based in Denmark, where most work will take place. Some international travel will be required for fieldwork, test-site visits, and collaboration with project partners.

   

  Who we are looking for

  We are looking for a researcher interested in how interdisciplinary collaboration works in practice, with the ability to move between research, facilitation, and development.

   

  You should have:

   	
• The ability to work independently while contributing actively to a collaborative team 	
• Strong written and oral communication skills 	
• Willingness and ability to travel internationally when required    

  We are particularly interested in candidates with experience in one or more of the following:

   	
• Interdisciplinary higher education research 	
• Participatory action research or co-design 	
• Workshop facilitation and stakeholder engagement 	
• Developing or evaluating practical approaches to research and collaboration 	
• Translating research into practical or policy-relevant outputs 	
• Spoken or written Danish, which is an advantage but not a requirement   We welcome candidates from different disciplinary and methodological backgrounds and do not expect applicants to meet every criterion.

   

  What we offer

  You will join an international and collaborative research environment in central Copenhagen and become part of a project with a strong focus on research that makes a practical difference.

  The SPINE project is led by Associate Professor Katrine Ellemose Lindvig at the Section for Higher Education Research and Development, Department of Science Education, University of Copenhagen. The SPINE team consists of the PI, one postdoc, and one PhD student, and works closely with colleagues in a wider research group on Interdisciplinary Higher Education, which includes an additional PhD student. As postdoc, you will work closely together with the researchers in SPINE and this wider group, while also collaborating with external partners and stakeholders.

   

  Application

  Start date: 1 March 2027
 Application deadline: 1 November 2026, 23:59 CET
  

  Please submit a single application of no more than 2 pages, combining:

   	
• Your motivation and qualifications for the position, including your relevant research, methodological, and facilitation experience. 	
• Your ideas for contributing to SPINE, including how you would approach testing and refining tools and methods, designing intervention workshops, and developing practical “plug-and-play” resources.    

  In addition, please include:

   	
• CV, including research, fieldwork, teaching, and project experience 	
• One publication that best demonstrates your research capabilities and fit with the position 	
• Publication list 	
• Diplomas and transcripts 	
• Contact details for two references   Applications must be submitted in English through the University of Copenhagen's online recruitment system.

  Before applying, prospective applicants are welcome to contact Associate Professor Katrine Ellemose Lindvig to discuss the position and how their experience might fit the project.
 
 Contact:
 Katrine Ellemose Lindvig
 Email: Katrine.lindvig@ind.ku.dk
  

  The University of Copenhagen is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace and welcomes applications from all qualified candidates.

_Do you want to join a global fund manager in energy infrastructure investments? If so, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) is currently looking for a Team Assistant to join our Investor Relations & Business Development (IR & BD) team based in Copenhagen.

_**Team

**We are seeking a motivated and organized Team Assistant to support our team members in our Investor Relations & Business Development (IR & BD) team. The IR & BD team at CIP is a global, high-performing unit responsible for all investor interactions and business development activities—from product and fund development to fundraising and client engagement. The team comprises approximately 70 professionals from 15 countries, with backgrounds in investment banking, management consulting, and law.

You will be also a part of a broader Executive Support team, and will report to Heidi Jensen, Sr. Personal Assistant.

**Role

**As a Team Assistant based in CIPs Copenhagen office you will be primarily supporting the EMEA team, within the broader Investor Relations team covering clients across the region. You will play a central role both internally and externally, and you will be the closest go-to person for your team in providing broad administrative support.

**Responsibilities will consist of but are not limited to:

**

• Organizing and maintaining calendars, ensuring alignment in daily schedule and keeping calendars up-to date

• Organizing travel arrangements and logistics and ensuring that roadshows are going smoothly

• Providing broad administrative support, e.g., managing incoming inquiries and scheduling meetings

• Updating CRM systems (e.g., Dealcloud) with relevant data

• Communicating with investors, e.g. replying to emails, sending invitations to events and press releases

**You

**You have around 5 years of relevant experience in administrative or coordinating roles, preferably from a consulting firm, law firm, investment bank, large international company or a Ministry/Government Agency. You thrive in a high-paced work environment and are motivated, thorough, and resourceful, with a high level of professionalism and able to handle confidential material discreetly.

**We look for the following in a candidate

**

• Solid knowledge of Office 365 applications

• Excellent communication and time management skills

• Ability to balance responsibilities in a busy environment across various projects with changing priorities

• Ability to grasp the big picture at the same time being thorough with a high attention to detail

• Ability to manage administrative processes and projects independently, at the same time enjoying sparring and collaborating with the team

• Resilient, service minded, proactive and with a positive can-do attitude

• Experience with CRM tools is a plus

• Project management – investor events, road shows

**The process

**Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

**Building value that matters

**Founded in 2012, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners P/S (CIP) today is the world’s largest dedicated fund manager within greenfield renewable energy investments and a global leader in offshore wind. To date, CIP has developed and constructed more than +50 greenfield renewable projects around the world. CIP is developing a greenfield project portfolio of ~160GW total, and ~16 GW is in operation or under construction. CIP manages 13 funds and has to date raised approximately EUR ~35 billion for investments in energy and associated infrastructure from more than ~200 international institutional investors.

CIP has a multinational team of ~500 full-time employees with extensive experience and knowledge within the fields of renewable energy project development and regulated infrastructure. In addition, CIP has a broad range of competencies within corporate finance, mergers & acquisitions, engineering, construction, project development, and project management.

CIP has built a prominent investment team capable of originating proprietary investment opportunities and executing projects and investments based on the team’s industrial background, large industrial network, and extensive experience in structuring, executing, and managing investments within energy infrastructure. Headquartered in Copenhagen, CIP also operates from key locations across the globe, including offices in Hamburg, Munich, London, Utrecht, New York, Tokyo, Melbourne, Luxembourg, Kuala Lumpur, Seoul and Singapore. In addition, CIP has 17 local project offices globally.

For more information, visit www.cip.com.

We’re looking for a commercially minded Legal Counsel to join us on our journey to become one stronger, more integrated SaaS business. You’ll work across commercial contracts, privacy and cybersecurity in the European and North American market, partnering with colleagues across the organisation to find practical solutions and support our growth.

Reporting to our General Counsel, you’ll work at the intersection of commercial law, privacy, cybersecurity and business transformation. You’ll play a key role in enabling business growth, supporting complex customer deals, and ensuring that our legal commitments are practical, proportionate and aligned with how we operate.

Whether you’re building on your experience in private practice or looking to grow further in an in-house role, this is an opportunity for you to take ownership, learn along the way, and make a real difference.

We are open to on-site (offices in Copenhagen and Wrocław), hybrid, and remote working within two time zones of our offices (CET), plus the US East Coast.

**About Us

**Cookie Information, Piwik PRO, and Sheltr, are leading SaaS brands specialising in privacy-first compliance and analytics. Together, we’re building intuitive, user-friendly products that help organisations navigate data privacy and marketing insights. With headquarters in Copenhagen and an office in Wrocław, our teams have been working across various industries to build trusted data privacy solutions since 2011.

We’re bringing our brands closer together to build one company with a shared identity in the group, a clear focus and ambitious plan for the future. The Legal, Compliance and Cybersecurity team has a core role to play in making that happen.

The role

These will be your main tasks:

Handle commercial contracts, particularly sales contracts

• Draft, review and negotiate customer contracts for EU and US customers.

• Support partner, reseller and supplier agreements, as well as more specialised regulatory requirements such as DORA-related terms and US healthcare BAAs.

• Work closely with Sales and Account Management to find solutions that support our commercial goals while managing legal risks.

Privacy compliance and cybersecurity

• Support GDPR compliance, international data transfers, sub-processor management and relevant UK and US privacy requirements.

• Work with our Cybersecurity team on NIS2 compliance and related contractual requirements.

• Help our Cyber Security and Compliance teams to respond to customer privacy and security questionnaires, audits and due diligence requests.

• Advise Product teams on privacy, consent and data protection, helping ensure that our commitments reflect how we actually work.

Help shape the way we work

• Improve legal templates, processes and ways of working as the business grows.

• Collaborate with colleagues across Sales, Product, Security, Finance and Operations.

• Contribute to shaping our legal function and how we support the wider business.

**About You

**You’re a structured, independent, and commercially minded lawyer who enjoys working with people and finding practical solutions. You combine sound legal judgement with a practical understanding of how a business operates. You’re comfortable challenging assumptions, thinking creatively and making decisions, even when the answer isn’t entirely straightforward.

You know that good legal advice is not just about identifying risks; it’s about helping the business understand those risks and finding a way forward.

You bring:

• 2-5 years of experience with commercial contracts, gained in-house or at a law firm.

• An understanding of B2B contracting and an interest in SaaS or technology businesses.

• Working knowledge of GDPR and privacy law in a commercial context, or relevant experience with HIPAA and US privacy law.

• The ability to communicate clearly, and comfortable working directly with Sales on live deals and making pragmatic judgement calls.

• Fluency in English (C2).

Nice-to-haves

• Experience with cybersecurity regulations (NIS2 and/or DORA).

• Experience with HIPAA, including negotiating BAAs.

• Knowledge of corporate governance, employment/HR legal matters (DK, PL, DE, and/or US).

• Experience with US customers and US commercial contracting, including state privacy laws and/or wiretap/tracking litigation risk.

• Experience building processes and templates in a growing legal function.

What we offer

• The opportunity to make a real impact. You’ll help shape a growing international SaaS business as it evolves towards a more integrated, enterprise-ready organisation. You won’t simply be maintaining existing processes; you’ll help develop the legal and commercial foundations for our next stage of growth.

• International exposure and commercial ownership. You’ll work on customer and partner relationships across the US and Europe, gaining exposure to complex commercial negotiations and a broad range of legal and regulatory challenges.

• The chance to broaden your expertise, take ownership of meaningful projects and grow with the business.

• Professional development budget, health insurance, and other benefits.

• A positive, informal workplace.

Application process

We’re looking to fill the position as soon as possible and will be inviting candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so don’t hesitate to send your application today.

This is what our recruitment process looks like:

• A brief screening call with our Talent Partner (online, approx. 30 mins)

• An in-depth interview with the General Counsel and a stakeholder from the company (online)

• A final interview with our General Counsel including a live case (online or in-person, TBD)

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

At Cookie Information & Piwik PRO we value diversity as a cornerstone of our success. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability. We recognise that certain groups are underrepresented in the tech industry, and we encourage everyone to apply and help us shape a more inclusive workspace.
